qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve adult streamer, blue/white varsity layers, pink accents, headphones, ring-light phone rig and bunny charm. No added golden-fist motifs. Review limited bubble swarm, ring-light/phone continuity, title and keying around pale trim.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact young adult brown-skinned man with short black locs and electric-blue strands, stud earrings, blue-and-white varsity jacket over a white hoodie, black cargo trousers with blue straps and white graphic marks, blue-white-pink high-top sneakers with pink laces, pink-and-black headphones around his neck, pink crossbody strap and black bag with the tiny white bunny charm. 2.5–3.5s: camera races back along the bubble trail to his smiling face. The two leading bubbles shrink into small reactions beside the phone as exact title RAID THE CHAT slams below his headphones in two bold comic lines.
3.5–5s: return to complete-character selfie pose. His little bunny bag charm swings up and blocks the phone lens; he gently flicks it aside and instantly resumes his practiced grin. Ring light stays a recognizable physical prop, not a second character. SFX: phone tap, two bright notification pings, accelerating swarm whoosh, enormous comic balloon POP with bass, title impact, tiny charm jingle. No voices, cheers, music or golden-fist symbols.

IDENTITY: exact tall slim adult brown-skinned man with expressive eyebrows, short black goatee, green work cap with its existing white emblem, green long-sleeve shirt, blue bib overalls with two round silver buttons, black wrist cuffs, brown belt and tan lace-up work boots. 0–0.7s: full-body stance beside the tool bag. He grabs the steel ratchet wrench and gives one small floating brass bolt a hard quarter turn. That turn magically reveals one ENORMOUS steel compression spring beneath his boots, a stylized isolated game prop with no real construction steps.
0.7–2.5s: camera pulls far back as he presses the giant spring down to a pancake with a deep crouch. It releases with an explosive metallic BOING, launching him high through cyan space. 3.5–5s: hero hold. The giant spring shrinks to one tiny coil that drops into the bag; the bag gives a single small startled hop. He looks down, taps it once with the wrench, and it settles. SFX: ratchet click, enormous spring strain, dominant launch BOING, rushing ascent, powerful metal gear impact, receding flywheel whistle, title clack and tiny final bag thump. qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve adult woman's black bob, forest-green sweater, cream trousers, green canvas shoes and iced matcha cup. Matcha effects use olive/chartreuse and cream with dark outlines, not turquoise. Review liquid creature shape, cup/straw continuity, full-body establishment and long three-line title.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult light-skinned woman with sharp green eyes, short straight black bob and blunt bangs, oversized dark forest-green ribbed sweater, loose cream trousers and green/off-white canvas sneakers. Preserve the enormous clear cup of iced matcha with cream marbling, green straw, clear lid and olive-green ice reflections. Keep her intensely focused, caffeine-powered comic attitude.
0–0.7s: establish her entire compact crouched pose and both shoes. She takes one emphatic sip of matcha. Her eyes sharpen; she pulls the straw out and holds it like a conductor's baton, gripping the cup securely in the other hand.
0.7–2.5s: one sudden upward straw flick pulls a towering SPIRAL of opaque olive-green matcha and ivory cream from the cup. Camera whips upward and far back as the spiral forms one colossal tea KOI with a broad flowing tail and fierce comic face, many times larger than her body. The koi lunges in one spectacular overhead arc and crunches a giant isolated pale-ivory ice cube into sparkling chunky pieces. One dominant creamy impact burst with inked olive edges, a brief bite-contact hold, then an accelerating curve back toward the little cup. This is a stylized liquid creature with bounded solid silhouettes, no aquarium, water surface, fog or translucent cyan/teal effect.
2.5–3.5s: she twists the straw once; the enormous koi spirals neatly back into her cup through its lid opening, collapsing from huge to tiny. Snap close to her unbothered face as exact title CEREMONIAL GRADE CRASHOUT slams in THREE stable readable lines below the cup, away from her eyes.
3.5–5s: return to complete crouched hero view. She resumes sipping as one final little ice cube lands in the cup with a loud CLINK. Her eye twitches once, then she takes another tiny satisfied sip. Cup, hands and bob hairstyle stay stable. SFX: strong straw slurp, rising liquid cyclone, immense koi whoosh, one explosive ice CRUNCH, swirling suction return, title slam, isolated ice clink. No music, speech or golden-fist emblems.
